title: Follow the river down the path of devastation in Nepal and China after landslide | CNN
text:
Source: CNN

Massive landslides and catastrophic flash floods have wreaked havoc at the Nepal-China border, destroying houses, wiping out bridges andkilling at least 616 peoplesince the landslide on August 26. Additionally, about2,500 people are still unaccounted foron both the Nepali and Chinese sides of the border.

More rain is expectedin flood-affected areas this weekend and officials are closely monitoringtwo newly formed lakescreated by the landslide, which have fueled concerns about further flooding.

Video footage and satellite imagery shows the immense scale of the disaster in some of the areas hit hardest by the floods.

—CNN’s Yong Xiong and Thomas Bordeaux contributed to this report
